title: diag bybit_open_orders (all accounts) times out / 502s: reads Bybit accounts serially through the single-worker account executor; the live-review packet's venue-order read fails
note: MEASURED 2026-11-15: the all-accounts call took 30.7 s -> 502 at Caddy, then 21.2 s; a single account takes ~6 s. The live-review packets at ~04:05Z and 04:10Z reported bybit_orders timed_out_after_connect (manager: 2/2 tonight), so mechanics could not read venue SL/TP for real-money ADA. Same root cause as DIAG-EXCHANGE-POSITIONS-SLOW (#26163): serial run_account_read. Fix: run_account_read_parallel + per-account deadline + read_state/elapsed_s, as #26163 did. CORRECTION: I said #26202 was web-api only with no trader restart. That was wrong. 'echo src/web/api/routers/diag.py | python3 scripts/ops/trader_import_closure.py decide' returns RESTART (in_closure), the same as #26163. #26202 is approved at head 2014d1a8; the manager is batching it with #26203 (or merging it alone at 05:30Z). Lesson: run the decide tool before claiming restart impact. MERGED 05:02Z as one restart batch with #26203 (squash f0a088a0). landed_unproven. CLOSING OBSERVATION: an all-accounts bybit_open_orders read answers in under ~15 s with orders_read on every Bybit account (deadline_s + elapsed_s present), and the next live-review packet carries no bybit_orders read error. Check scheduled 05:15Z.
